description: Delcorn is an independent training provider delivering levy-funded apprenticeships and commercial programmes in AI, data, digital, leadership and people practice to large UK employers. Delivery is fully remote, built around expert skills coaches, live workshops and the Aptiva e-portfolio.

values: Learner first — every decision starts with the apprentice
Grow together — coaches, employers and learners as one team
Evidence over opinion — we measure what matters
Responsible with AI — curious, ethical and practical

timeline.event: Founded in London by Helena Marsh to bring data skills to large employers
Joined the Register of Apprenticeship Training Providers; first 120 apprentices
First full Ofsted inspection — Good in all areas
Moved to fully remote delivery; Aptiva e-portfolio rolled out
Launched the Data Academy and Leadership Academy
Launched the AI Academy; named Training Provider of the Year at the (fictional) Skills Excellence Awards
Acquired by Meridian Education Group; remains operationally independent
Ofsted inspection under the new report-card framework — 'Strong standard' in all areas
Launched the Level 4 AI & Automation Practitioner programme and the first apprenticeship units

glossary.definition: Off-the-job training — training during paid hours, away from normal duties, required for every apprentice
Individualised Learner Record — the monthly data return to the Department for Education that drives funding
End-point assessment / the independent organisation that conducts it
The checkpoint where employer, provider and apprentice agree the apprentice is ready for EPA
Knowledge, skills and behaviours defined by each apprenticeship standard
Digital Apprenticeship Service — the employer account holding levy funds
The 5% contribution paid by non-levy employers towards training costs
Statutory duty to help prevent people being drawn into terrorism
Self-assessment report — annual evaluation of quality against the Ofsted framework
Quality improvement plan — actions arising from the SAR
Break in learning — a planned pause in an apprenticeship
Red/Amber/Green progress rating used in reviews and caseload reports
Completers who achieved ÷ all leavers in the year (completed + withdrawn)

people.name: Helena Marsh
people.title: Chief Executive Officer & Founder
people.bio: Founded Delcorn in 2015 after a career in data consultancy. Chairs the executive team and sits on the Meridian Education Group UK board.
people.persona_notes: Big-picture, impatient with detail, wants one-page summaries. Asks 'what does this mean for learners?' Often asks for board-ready narratives at short notice.

people.name: David Okafor
people.title: Chief Operating Officer
people.bio: Leads delivery, safeguarding operations and learning technology. Previously ran operations at a national FE college group.
people.persona_notes: Operational, KPI-driven. Lives in Power BI. Wants caseload, OTJ and review compliance data cut by academy every Monday.

people.name: Priya Raman
people.title: Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Chartered accountant (ACA). Owns finance, funding assurance and the relationship with Meridian Group finance.
people.persona_notes: Precise and risk-aware. Will challenge any number without a source. Worried about funding audit findings and levy policy changes.

people.name: Tom Whitfield
people.title: Chief Commercial Officer
people.bio: Leads employer partnerships, business development and marketing.
people.persona_notes: Energetic, relationship-led. Wants proposal drafts fast and pipeline forecasts he can trust.

people.name: Dr Siân Llewellyn
people.title: Director of Quality & Compliance
people.bio: Former Ofsted inspector (fictional history). Leads self-assessment, quality improvement and inspection readiness.
people.persona_notes: Evidence-obsessed. Needs everything mapped to the inspection framework. Hates unverified claims.

people.name: Marcus Bell
people.title: People Director
people.bio: Leads HR, recruitment, CPD and wellbeing for a fully remote workforce.
people.persona_notes: Empathetic; wants policy answers to be consistent and kind. Fields lots of repetitive policy questions from staff.

people.name: Aisha Karim
people.title: Director of Learning Technology
people.bio: Owns Aptiva, Microsoft 365, data and information security. Sponsor of the Copilot rollout.
people.persona_notes: Champion of Copilot and automation, but cautious about data protection and oversharing in SharePoint.

people.name: Dr Ben Hartley
people.title: Head of AI & Curriculum
people.bio: Machine-learning PhD; leads the five academies and curriculum design.
people.persona_notes: Thoughtful and academic. Wants curriculum content to stay current with fast-moving AI policy.

people.name: Rachel Moss
people.title: Head of Delivery
people.bio: Started as Delcorn's fourth skills coach; now leads 70+ coaches and tutors.
people.persona_notes: Pragmatic, protective of coaches' time. Spends hours compiling caseload reports and chasing overdue reviews.

people.name: Grace Adeyemi
people.title: Head of Safeguarding & Designated Safeguarding Lead
